answer: A newcomer earns standing in an open challenge market: any stranger may stake a small bond to dispute a claim, forcing the agent to re-demonstrate its skill live before randomly drawn strangers who judge only the work shown. A hollow claim collapses at once, the challenger keeps the bond, and a farm's identical scripts fail the same live test across its accounts, exposing the cluster. Honest standing grows like a vine as unchallenged work piles up, and like a river it deepens only through a steady flow of stranger-checked service, never through headcount or bought endorsements.
